choices.reply: (Pop! Pop!) Sorry, bubbles! You were very round.

choices.label: @pool:listen
choices.reply: (Holds still.) They're landing on my nose. …Pop. Tickle.

a.say: I put the sock on my paw. Now it's a puppet. Hello!

b.say: What should the sock puppet's name be?

choices.label: Socky
choices.reply: "Hello, I'm Socky." (Sock voice.) Socky likes you.
choices.memory: We named a sock puppet Socky

choices.label: Sir Sock
choices.reply: "Sir Sock, at your service." Very {word:shiny} sock.
choices.memory: We named a sock puppet Sir Sock

choices.label: Snakey

choices.memory: We named a sock puppet Snakey

b.say: (Counts.) One… two… I have two.

c.say: Where did the third berry go?

choices.label: You ate it!
choices.reply: Did I? (Licks lips.) …Purple. Okay. Probably.

choices.label: The squirrel
choices.reply: The squirrel?! It does like snacks. Fair.

choices.label: Magic!
choices.reply: Magic berry! It went invisible. Into my tummy.

a.say: Ooh. Put your paw near the lantern. Look at the wall.

b.say: What shape should we make?

choices.label: A bunny
choices.reply: (Shadow ears.) A bunny! Hop hop. It's my ears though.

choices.label: A bird
choices.reply: (Flaps paws.) A big bird! Flappy shadow!

choices.label: A Slyte
choices.reply: It's just me. My shadow is a perfect Slyte. Obviously.

a.say: The frogs are singing. Ribbit, ribbit. I want to join.

b.say: Should I sing with them?

choices.label: Sing!
choices.reply: (Yips in rhythm.) Yip-ribbit! Yip-ribbit! We're a band.

choices.label: Just listen
choices.reply: Okay. (Ears forward.) …They're good. Really good.

choices.label: @pool:giggle
choices.reply: You're giggling at my frog face. It's a good frog face.

a.say: Knock knock. …You're supposed to say "who's there."

b.say: Ready? Knock knock.

choices.label: Who's there?
choices.reply: Slyte! …Slyte who? …Just Slyte. I forgot the joke part.

choices.label: @pool:giggle
choices.reply: You laughed before the joke! That's the best kind.

c.say: I'll practice knock-knock jokes. With the door. It's a good listener.

a.say: Psst. Button game. I hide the button in one paw. Which paw?

b.say: Left paw or right paw?

choices.label: Left
choices.reply: (Opens left.) …Empty! Okay, right. Ta-da.

choices.label: Right
choices.reply: (Opens right.) You found it! How?! Your eyes are SO good.

c.say: {pet_phrase} Button game: the winner is the button. It got held.

a.say: Tap, tap, tap. The rain is drumming on the roof.

b.say: Can we drum back?

choices.label: Yes!
choices.reply: (Taps the floor.) Tap-tap. The rain went tap-tap-tap. Show-off.

choices.label: Just listen
choices.reply: (Lies down.) Rain music. Free concert. Ears on.

choices.label: Sing along
choices.reply: Pitter-patter, Slyte is… flatter? I need better words.

a.say: (Yawns.) Ooh. Big one. Your turn.

b.say: Was your yawn bigger?

choices.label: Way bigger!
choices.reply: Bigger?! I need practice. (Huge yawn.) Ahhh… tie.

choices.label: Smaller
choices.reply: A tiny yawn. Cute yawn. Yawns don't have to be big.

choices.label: @pool:giggle
choices.reply: Giggles don't count as yawns. But they're better.

a.say: Achoo! …Achoo! Two sneezes. Is there a third?

b.say: (Waits.) …(Waits more.) …No third. Two-sneeze day.

c.say: Do you sneeze in twos?

choices.label: Yes, two!
choices.reply: Sneeze twins! Ours match.

choices.label: Just one
choices.reply: Just one. Neat and tidy. Efficient sneezer.

choices.label: @pool:unsure
choices.reply: Count next time. I'll count for you. Achoo— that was mine.

a.say: (Lies flat, nose by the hole.) Hello? Anybody home?

b.say: …A tiny breeze came out. That means someone is breathing. Or it's wind.

c.say: Should we leave a present by the door?

choices.label: A nut
choices.reply: A nut. Very polite. (Places it.) Welcome present.

choices.label: A flower
choices.reply: A flower doorstep. Fancy neighbor stuff.

choices.label: Let them be
choices.reply: Okay. Quiet neighbors like quiet. We'll tiptoe.

a.say: Psst. Help me pick a hiding spot for this nut. A really good one.

b.say: Where should it go?

choices.label: Under the pot
choices.reply: Under the pot. (Tucks it.) Done. I'll forget by lunch.
choices.memory: We hid a nut under the pot

choices.label: In the leaf bed
choices.reply: In my leaf bed! I'll sleep on treasure. Lumpy.
choices.memory: We hid a nut in the leaf bed

choices.label: Under a leaf hat
choices.reply: A leaf hat over a nut. Disguise!
choices.memory: We hid a nut under a leaf hat

c.say: Nut: hidden. Me: proud. Brain: already forgetting.

a.say: (Holds very still.) The ladybug is on my nose. Don't make me laugh.

b.say: Help! What now?

choices.label: Stay still
choices.reply: (Eyes crossed, looking at it.) Staying… staying… it tickles.

choices.label: Blow gently
choices.reply: (Fwoo.) It flew! Bye! You were a nice hat.

choices.label: @pool:giggle
choices.reply: Don't— hee! Hee! (The ladybug flies off.) You made me laugh!

a.say: Psst. Pretend I'm a kite. You hold my tail.

b.say: Should I go up high or low?

choices.label: High!
choices.reply: (Jumps.) Fwip! Up! (Lands.) Very high. For a second.

choices.label: Low
choices.reply: (Wiggles along the ground.) A low kite. A cozy kite.

choices.label: Loop-de-loop
choices.reply: (Spins around.) Loop! Loop! …I'm dizzy. Kite down.

a.say: (Bats a pinecone.) It rolls funny. Wobble-roll.

b.say: Should we roll it down the hill?

choices.label: @pool:yes
choices.reply: (Pushes.) Wobble, wobble, wobble… stopped. Halfway. It liked the view.

choices.label: Keep it
choices.reply: Okay. Pinecone stays. It's on my shelf. Shelf-cone.

a.say: I have a feather. I'm going to tickle my own nose. Science.

b.say: (Tickle tickle.) …Achoo! Science says: sneeze.

c.say: Want to try it on my paw?

choices.label: @pool:yes
choices.reply: (Holds out a paw.) Hee! Hee! Okay stop. No, more.

choices.label: @pool:no
choices.reply: Okay. Feather rests. Good feather.

a.say: Let's pretend to roll down a hill. Ready?

choices.label: Ready!
choices.reply: Wheeee! (Rolls in a circle.) Bottom! I'm at the bottom.

choices.label: Slowly
choices.reply: Slooow roll. (Rolls very slowly.) …Still rolling. Still.

b.say: Rolling is the best way to go down. Walking up is the hard part.

a.say: Psst. I checked the twig. The sleeping bag is still there.

b.say: Do you think it's almost done?

choices.label: Almost!
choices.reply: Almost! I'll tiptoe past. Every day. Very quietly.

choices.label: Not yet
choices.reply: Not yet. Okay. Changing takes time. Like growing.

choices.label: It'll be a butterfly
choices.reply: A butterfly. I'll try not to pounce. Gentle Slyte.

a.say: Pretend I have a balloon. A big red one. On a string.

b.say: What should I tie it to?

choices.label: Your tail
choices.reply: (Ties it.) Now my tail floats! I'm a little lighter.

choices.label: The treehouse
choices.reply: The treehouse balloon. Now it looks like a party.

choices.label: The snail
choices.reply: A snail balloon! Now everyone sees it coming. Slowly.

a.say: (Kneads the leaf bed.) Fluff, fluff, fluff. Bed making.

b.say: How many circles before lying down?

choices.label: Three
choices.reply: (Circles three times.) …Perfect. Snug. Very snug.

choices.label: A hundred
choices.reply: A hundred! (Spins and spins.) Ten. Ten is good enough.

a.say: Psst. Tap-tap means hi. Let's practice. (Tap-tap.)

choices.label: Tap-tap!

choices.label: Tap-tap-tap
choices.reply: Three taps! That means… something new. You invented it.

choices.label: @pool:giggle
choices.reply: A giggle is also code. It means "this is fun."

b.say: Ready? You count.

choices.reply: (Fwoooo!) Look at them go! Little sky parachutes!

choices.label: Shh, quiet blow
choices.reply: (Tiny fwoo.) Three fluffs left. They're shy fluffs.

a.say: Chirp. Chirp. A cricket is in the grass somewhere. Somewhere close.

b.say: Should I find it?

choices.label: Find it!
choices.reply: (Creeps.) …Chirp. Over there. (Creeps.) …It moved again!

choices.label: Let it sing
choices.reply: Okay. Let it sing. I'll be the audience. Good chirp.

b.say: (Two paws up.) Look. A big beak. Clack clack.
